title: GS8 release v1 price table
purpose: Price data for tools/build_release_bom.py. Prices are data, not code: edit this file and re-run the generator. Every purchasable BOM line has an entry here (priced or not_found with a reason); the generator fails on a missing or unknown id.
status: Planning prices only. Nothing was purchased, no cart was used and no supplier was contacted. No figure is a landed quote. Updated 2026-10-01 for the all-printed release (no custom metal; Loctite 425 only): retired metal/shim/old fastener entries removed, new lines entered as not_found; no new prices were taken.

gst_basis_legend.included: SGD figure already includes GST (GST-inclusive quote, or a 21 Sep figure that already carries the 9 % allowance); used as is
gst_basis_legend.excluded: SGD page price shown before GST (DigiKey SG); the generator adds the 9 % GST allowance
gst_basis_legend.as_displayed: SGD retail price used as displayed; GST treatment not checked (MakerSupplies SG, Cytron SG), the same convention as the 21 Sep lists
gst_basis_legend.usd_list: USD price; the generator converts it as USD x fx.rate x (1 + gst_allowance) - an estimate

confidence_legend.carried_quote: SGD quote from the 21 Sep lists (outputs/bom-2026-09-21/bom-data.json), carried because item, SKU and vendor are unchanged; stock not re-checked on 25 Sep
confidence_legend.seen_on_page: the price was read from the fetched supplier page or its product data on 2026-09-25
confidence_legend.estimate: the price came from a search-engine snippet, a sibling part, or a carried USD list converted at FX; it was not seen on a fetched page for this exact SKU

shipping: Excluded from every figure. US, Tindie and maker-store orders add shipping and import GST; the LiPo pack ships as dangerous goods.

price_unit_legend.each: price per piece; line = purchase qty x price
price_unit_legend.pack: price per pack; line = packs x price (packs given per entry)

pricing_pass.note: DigiKey SG prices are recorded as displayed, before GST. For MakerSupplies SG, whether the displayed price includes GST was not checked. USD prices are converted with the FX and GST allowance above.

flags.text: C&K A10403RNZB is not a listed DigiKey SG part. In the A10403RN family the solder-lug variants are silver (A10403RNZQ, S$14.02 ex GST, 138 in stock) and the only gold variant is PC-pin (A10403RNCBK, S$18.24 bulk, 0 stock). Decide the MPN or relax the gold / solder-lug spec before ordering; the line stays unpriced.
Kingbright WP7113 is a T-1 3/4 (5 mm) series per DigiKey, but netlist_source.py D1-D3 and the BOM say 3 mm. Check the LED size or MPN against the panel bore before ordering.

The 1-pole NKK MB2011SS1G01 family is obsolete at DigiKey (0 stock). The line is priced on the 2-pole MB2061SS1G01 as a placeholder (use one pole); a stocked 1-pole gold panel momentary was not searched.
Bourns 4610X-101-103LF: 0 in stock at DigiKey SG, 200 due 14-Dec-2026. Pick a stocked SIP-10 10k x9 bussed network.
TE 5-1437624-7 (21 Sep hold) is not shown as an alias of PKG100B1/4; confirm they are the same knob (bore, set screws) before ordering.

Out of stock at the seen source on 25 Sep: SC1129 300 mm at MakerSupplies SG (element14 SG 4263051 lists it, price not seen); Adafruit 1609 at Adafruit; CNC Kitchen M3 x 5.7 and 1/4"-20 at Printed Solid.
The DROK page lists input DC 5-40 V in the specs and DC 8-40 V in the title; the 3S LiHV range (9.65-13.05 V) is inside both. USD 8.00 is a sale price (was USD 12.30).
A13JB showed S$7.51967 (reads like a break price); confirm the qty-1 price.

Printed Solid insert prices are per pack; the piece count is not shown in the variant data. One pack per size is assumed to cover the purchase quantity (CNC Kitchen's own store sells 100-piece packs); confirm before ordering. The PROTO1 saddle inserts are counted in INS-M2.5.
Prices come from search-engine snippets (supplier pages blocked the fetcher); re-check on the page. PWR-01 ships as dangerous goods: landed cost and SG availability unknown.
